assumptions: light cones to t = 18 (tables of 2^19 entries)
surjectivity and injectivity on bi-infinite rows by the pair-graph (Garden of Eden) criterion
falsification: A rule number that is not a multiple of 17, or an XOR light cone that is not 2^popcount(t).
hypothesis: H-C15-0 (calibration): the 16 automata are exactly the elementary rules that ignore the left neighbour, i.e. the multiples of 17; XOR (rule 102) has 2^popcount(t) essential cells (Gould's sequence A001316) and bounded streaming width.
methodology: Compute the Wolfram number of each table, the essential variables and the forward/backward ordered-BDD widths of F_t, nilpotency (F_t constant), pair-graph surjectivity/injectivity and the functional graph of the global map on all cyclic rows of each length.
question: Which elementary CA rules are the automata c'_i = c_i * c_{i+1} of the 16 two-element magmas, and how do their light cones, streaming widths, surjectivity and cyclic dynamics look?
title: Two-element magma automata: elementary rules 17m, light cones, surjectivity and cyclic dynamics
